decisions.reason: The certified gasketed plate heat exchanger line remains close to the core heat-exchange portfolio and relevant for climate-control customers, although later website silence and strong competition in HVAC raise some pruning risk.

The marine box cooler system should be retained because it builds directly on established marine capabilities and already showed strong market acceptance through quality reputation and major market share.
The marine cooling unit still fits the firm's marine systems and service strategy well, even if there is less visible evidence of traction than for the strongest marine offering.

The compact oil cooler is a sensible adjacent product for multiple industrial applications and aftermarket support, but it carries a somewhat higher rationalization risk if demand or differentiation proves modest.
Finned tubes for air coolers support the broader exchanger and service business, yet as a more component-like line with limited later visibility they are more exposed to portfolio streamlining.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes match the firm's R&D-led efficiency positioning and upgrade business, so continuation is more likely than discontinuation.
